name: Kuramoto Chihiro no Jikenbo
source:
Observation Skills: 100 Points, Deduction Skills: 0 Points!?
She can't read the mood, but she can read the truth behind a case—
A novel game full of laughs and a little thrill, unfolding between the enigmatic "non-delusional girl" Chihiro Kuramoto and you (the protagonist), who has a knack for getting involved in trouble, is here!
translation:
观察能力：100点，推理能力：0点！？
她看不懂心情，但她能读懂案件背后的真相——
神秘的“非妄想少女”仓本千寻和擅长卷入麻烦的你（主角）之间展开的充满欢笑和小刺激的小说游戏就在这里！
